resources.string: LegalEase follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). This notice explains what the app processes, where, and for how long.

• Documents you upload or photograph, and the text read from them.
• The results of each analysis.
• Contracts you create, including the names, addresses, and ID types you type in.
• Your email address and name, to sign you in.
• App diagnostics: crash reports, performance timings, and usage events. These never include document content.

• Reading, analyzing, and creating contracts happen on this phone. Your documents and their text do not leave it.
• Sign-in uses Google Firebase Authentication.
• Diagnostics go to Google Firebase (Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Analytics).
• Cloud backup is off unless you turn it on. If you do, your analysis results and the contracts you create are stored in Google Cloud Firestore in Singapore. Uploaded documents and their full text are never uploaded.

• On this phone: until you delete it, or until it reaches your history setting (30, 90, or 365 days, or never).
• Cloud backup: until you delete the item or your account.
• Diagnostics: for the retention period of the Google services above.
Everything is encrypted on the phone.

You have the right to be informed, to access and correct your data, to object, to have it erased or blocked, to receive a copy (data portability), and to complain to the National Privacy Commission. In Privacy & data you can export everything or delete your account. To contact us, use the email address on LegalEase\'s Google Play listing.
Control what is kept, where, and for how long.
Back up analysis results and contracts you create to your account. Documents and their text stay on this phone.

LegalEase will store, in Google Cloud Firestore in Singapore and under your account:
• each analysis result: document name, classification, confidence, and summary;
• each contract you create: its text and the details you entered (names, addresses, ID types).

Uploaded documents and the text read from them are never uploaded. You can turn this off at any time; to remove what was uploaded, delete your account.
Analyses older than this are deleted automatically, from this phone and from cloud backup.
Ask for your fingerprint, face, or screen lock when LegalEase opens.
Set up a screen lock in your phone\'s settings to use this.
A ZIP file with your analyses, documents, contracts (as PDFs), settings, and activity log.

This permanently deletes your LegalEase account, your cloud backup, and everything on this phone: analyses, documents, contracts, settings, and the activity log. It cannot be undone.\n\nExport your data first if you want a copy.
This phone did not pass Google Play\'s integrity check (it may be rooted or modified). Offline analysis is turned off; results use basic checks only.
For your security, sign out and sign in again, then delete your account within five minutes.
